# Chantal Mental Health Counseling

> Online therapy (secure video) for teens (13-17) and adults anywhere in New York State, with Chantal Amoussou, LMHC-D, a Licensed Mental Health Counselor in New York. Sessions in English, French and Mina.

- Services: therapy for anxiety, depression, substance use, bipolar disorder, OCD and stress. Approaches include cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), motivational interviewing and trauma-informed care. No couples counseling.
- Format: online only (telehealth) for clients located in New York State. No in-person office.
- Hours: 7 am to 10 pm Eastern, 7 days a week, by appointment.
- Fees: self-pay $200 per session.
- Insurance accepted: Aetna, Cigna, Optum, Oxford, Tricare East. Coverage is confirmed before the first session.
- Phone: (516) 614-4116 (answered 24/7 by a virtual assistant who takes callback requests)
- Email: chantal@chantalmentalhealth.com (please do not send health details by email)
- Request an appointment: https://chantalmentalhealth.com/request-appointment/
- Crisis: this practice is not for emergencies. Call or text 988, or call 911 if in immediate danger.
